76d57817ab66e5e1052caa6cf377b0ace361c951.french: Si être autoritaire signifie imposer toutes les décisions sans écouter l'enfant, je ne suis pas d'accord. Cela ne veut pas dire renoncer aux limites. Pour moi, il faut expliquer les règles, écouter l'enfant et lui apprendre peu à peu à décider.

7f8a0623f006bd03e9ef53e24d6b405e88639e49.french: Prenons l'exemple d'un enfant qui avoue avoir abîmé un livre de bibliothèque. Si son parent l'écoute sans crier, ils peuvent ensuite contacter la bibliothèque ensemble pour savoir comment remplacer le livre, plutôt que le laisser cacher ce qui s'est passé.
7f8a0623f006bd03e9ef53e24d6b405e88639e49.english: Take a child who admits damaging a library book. If the parent listens without shouting, they can then contact the library together to find out how to replace the book, rather than leaving the child to hide what happened.
7f8a0623f006bd03e9ef53e24d6b405e88639e49.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

7fc1628fc0027ab2c5c6e4c29b6970752532f4d9.english: If a child expects to be shouted at before they’ve even had a chance to explain themselves, they may hide what has happened. The problem then remains unresolved, and the parent cannot help them.
7fc1628fc0027ab2c5c6e4c29b6970752532f4d9.french: S'il s'attend à des cris avant même d'avoir pu s'expliquer, il risque de cacher ce qui s'est passé. Le problème reste alors sans solution, et le parent ne peut pas l'aider.

8011cf8ee11d0eba30a1a0cbd6a9f3d4688c0372.english: While the baby is having a nap, a seven-year-old boy sounds the siren on his toy truck. His father tells him, 'You can keep playing, but without the siren, so the baby can sleep.'
8011cf8ee11d0eba30a1a0cbd6a9f3d4688c0372.french: Pendant la sieste du bébé, un garçon de sept ans fait sonner la sirène de son camion jouet. Son père lui dit : « Tu peux continuer à jouer, mais sans la sirène, pour laisser dormir le bébé. »
8011cf8ee11d0eba30a1a0cbd6a9f3d4688c0372.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

8504b331da9f5501f4cd9f9628fa7b57330e000d.english: A teenager must be home before 10 pm because transport becomes infrequent afterwards. They choose their outing, check their route and let their parents know if they are delayed.
8504b331da9f5501f4cd9f9628fa7b57330e000d.french: Un adolescent doit rentrer avant vingt-deux heures parce que les transports deviennent rares ensuite. Il choisit sa sortie, vérifie son trajet et prévient en cas de retard.
8504b331da9f5501f4cd9f9628fa7b57330e000d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

88aece58b77ec26868dcfff99313861bc41055bb.french: Par exemple, des parents peuvent demander que les téléphones restent de côté pendant le repas pour que chacun puisse raconter sa journée. S'ils rangent aussi les leurs, ils montrent qu'il s'agit de préserver un moment en famille, et non de priver seulement l'enfant.
88aece58b77ec26868dcfff99313861bc41055bb.english: For example, parents can ask for phones to be put aside during meals so everyone can talk about their day. If they put their own phones away too, they show that the aim is to preserve time together as a family, not just to deprive the child.
88aece58b77ec26868dcfff99313861bc41055bb.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed Famille response and user-provided reference; existing translation history is retained. No provider call was made.

88dd3b1e91b32011310a4c25c0df4c36c75e8d5d.english: The rule therefore helps the child to respect their little brother’s sleep.
88dd3b1e91b32011310a4c25c0df4c36c75e8d5d.french: La règle aide donc l'enfant à respecter le sommeil de son petit frère.

8a3f7fb29ad670b200e2c08e60eca8bbf730aeef.french: Les parents peuvent fixer ce qui doit être fait, puis laisser l'enfant proposer comment s'organiser. Des choix adaptés à son âge lui permettent d'apprendre à décider et à respecter les engagements qu'il a lui-même pris.
8a3f7fb29ad670b200e2c08e60eca8bbf730aeef.english: Parents can decide what needs to be done, then let the child suggest how to organise it. Age-appropriate choices let children learn to make decisions and follow through on commitments they have made themselves.
8a3f7fb29ad670b200e2c08e60eca8bbf730aeef.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

8ddfd5ace424f601a27974e8129a4d287b16256d.english: However, discussing matters does not mean that every rule must be endlessly negotiated. When faced with immediate danger, an adult must act first and explain afterwards. A boundary can be upheld firmly without threats or humiliation, and listening does not mean you have to accept every request.
8ddfd5ace424f601a27974e8129a4d287b16256d.french: Cependant, discuter ne signifie pas que chaque règle doit être négociée sans fin. Devant un danger immédiat, l'adulte doit intervenir d'abord et expliquer ensuite. Une limite peut rester ferme sans menaces ni humiliation, et l'écoute n'oblige pas à accepter toute demande.

977b240d64701fc0a1f9b4c56ba5b6976cc00f72.english: A teenager wants to unwind after coming home from school and suggests starting his homework at 5.00 pm. His mother agrees, on condition that it is finished before dinner. A week later, he is sticking to this timetable without her having to remind him every evening.
977b240d64701fc0a1f9b4c56ba5b6976cc00f72.french: Un adolescent veut souffler en rentrant du collège et propose de commencer ses devoirs à dix-sept heures. Sa mère accepte, à condition qu'ils soient terminés avant le dîner. Une semaine plus tard, il respecte cet horaire sans qu'elle ait à le lui rappeler chaque soir.

9c4d78f53c32a64a621eb6bfe9c360dc84685fac.french: Bien sûr, refuser l'autoritarisme ne veut pas dire tout permettre. Face à un danger, par exemple près d'une route, le parent doit intervenir immédiatement et expliquer ensuite. L'écoute n'empêche pas de poser des limites non négociables.
9c4d78f53c32a64a621eb6bfe9c360dc84685fac.english: Of course, rejecting authoritarianism does not mean allowing everything. Faced with danger, for example near a road, parents must intervene immediately and explain afterwards. Listening does not prevent them from setting non-negotiable limits.
9c4d78f53c32a64a621eb6bfe9c360dc84685fac.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed Famille response and user-provided reference; existing translation history is retained. No provider call was made.

9fb7e45f40c6854f64e80f4dafd05fd0704a3b31.french: Enfin, le but n'est pas que l'enfant obéisse toujours, mais qu'il devienne capable de se conduire seul.
9fb7e45f40c6854f64e80f4dafd05fd0704a3b31.english: Finally, the goal is not for children always to obey, but for them to become able to act independently.
9fb7e45f40c6854f64e80f4dafd05fd0704a3b31.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

9ff4aedab5832ccaadcf939c9ed0484e45475ec4.english: The child takes part in putting their mistake right instead of hiding it. Listening to them has not removed their responsibility.
9ff4aedab5832ccaadcf939c9ed0484e45475ec4.french: Il prend part à la réparation de son erreur au lieu de la cacher. L'écouter n'a pas supprimé sa responsabilité.
9ff4aedab5832ccaadcf939c9ed0484e45475ec4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

a818126a8a719de290a64cbf262e3b8504ad83cb.english: In conclusion, I prefer firm, consistent and well-explained authority to authoritarianism. Clear rules, the opportunity to have a say and age-appropriate choices help children to become independent, not just to obey.
a818126a8a719de290a64cbf262e3b8504ad83cb.french: En conclusion, je préfère une autorité ferme, cohérente et expliquée à l'autoritarisme. Des règles claires, la possibilité de parler et des choix adaptés à l'âge aident l'enfant à devenir autonome, pas seulement à obéir.

b0690ae86c6da3f4e53e3ddc7eb93c26b212d811.english: So I do not support authoritarianism. Fair, firm and explained authority protects children today while preparing them to decide for themselves tomorrow.
b0690ae86c6da3f4e53e3ddc7eb93c26b212d811.french: Donc, je ne suis pas pour l'autoritarisme. Une autorité juste, ferme et expliquée protège l'enfant aujourd'hui tout en le préparant à décider seul demain.
b0690ae86c6da3f4e53e3ddc7eb93c26b212d811.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b0943df8b9e846e19e51231ff95ba9b1b4b5e974.english: Parents can set out what needs to be done without deciding every single detail. The aim is not for parents to decide everything indefinitely, but for children to learn to organise themselves.
b0943df8b9e846e19e51231ff95ba9b1b4b5e974.french: Le parent peut fixer ce qui doit être fait sans décider de chaque détail. L'objectif n'est pas que le parent décide de tout indéfiniment, mais que l'enfant apprenne à s'organiser.

b75793a73c8a7efc2cace883ba9fae3e8b5ebcc4.english: Parents can decide what needs to be done, then let the child suggest how to do it. Giving children choices suited to their age helps them learn to make decisions and follow through on what they have agreed to do.
b75793a73c8a7efc2cace883ba9fae3e8b5ebcc4.french: Les parents peuvent fixer ce qui doit être fait, puis laisser l'enfant proposer comment s'organiser. Avec des choix adaptés à son âge, l'enfant apprend à prendre des décisions et à respecter les engagements qu'il a lui-même pris.
b75793a73c8a7efc2cace883ba9fae3e8b5ebcc4.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

b7e73fbba50418efd827ce029b569c988aeb6149.english: Finally, the aim is not for children always to obey, but for them to learn to choose.
b7e73fbba50418efd827ce029b569c988aeb6149.french: Enfin, le but n'est pas que l'enfant obéisse toujours, mais qu'il apprenne à choisir.
b7e73fbba50418efd827ce029b569c988aeb6149.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b8c0d1982810a3c0e8ec2dcadfd00a905494fde9.french: Un enfant ne peut pas encore décider seul de tout ce qui est bon pour lui. Des horaires réguliers, du temps pour les devoirs et des règles de respect l'aident à comprendre ce qu'on attend de lui. Ce cadre le protège et lui donne des habitudes utiles.
b8c0d1982810a3c0e8ec2dcadfd00a905494fde9.english: A child cannot yet decide alone everything that is good for them. Regular schedules, time for homework and rules about respect help them understand what is expected of them. These boundaries protect them and help them develop useful habits.
b8c0d1982810a3c0e8ec2dcadfd00a905494fde9.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed Famille response and user-provided reference; existing translation history is retained. No provider call was made.

c1828e9de21d225c2fd3761476d7c8231b8548ff.deepl_english: In this way, teenagers learn to organise their own work, rather than waiting for their parents to decide every step for them.
c1828e9de21d225c2fd3761476d7c8231b8548ff.english: In this way, the teenager learns to organise his own work, rather than waiting for his parent to decide every step for him.
c1828e9de21d225c2fd3761476d7c8231b8548ff.french: L'adolescent apprend ainsi à organiser son travail, au lieu d'attendre que son parent décide de chaque étape.
c1828e9de21d225c2fd3761476d7c8231b8548ff.review_note: Retains the individual teenager from the example rather than switching to teenagers and parents generally.

c190941184e65afbd72ec3a54180fdb0b54825e7.french: Ensuite, une autorité fondée sur la peur risque de pousser l'enfant à cacher ses erreurs.
c190941184e65afbd72ec3a54180fdb0b54825e7.english: Next, authority based on fear risks encouraging children to hide their mistakes.
c190941184e65afbd72ec3a54180fdb0b54825e7.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

c672b92f4d561a5259fde1b56c6eda5b3e7d136a.english: Next, overly harsh authority can produce silence rather than understanding.
c672b92f4d561a5259fde1b56c6eda5b3e7d136a.french: Ensuite, une autorité trop dure peut obtenir le silence plutôt que la compréhension.
c672b92f4d561a5259fde1b56c6eda5b3e7d136a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c69c014b38c4b85883067f42f7abb1fcafdc18ca.english: Parents can explain a rule and leave room for decisions appropriate to the child's age. The child then exercises their judgement rather than waiting for an order for every action. Firmness therefore does not prevent parents listening to their suggestions.
c69c014b38c4b85883067f42f7abb1fcafdc18ca.french: Les parents peuvent expliquer une règle et laisser une marge de décision adaptée à l'âge. L'enfant exerce alors son jugement au lieu d'attendre un ordre pour chaque geste. La fermeté n'empêche donc pas d'écouter ses propositions.
c69c014b38c4b85883067f42f7abb1fcafdc18ca.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c90be76b202f856f7b8ee7253e4a8c70f358b420.english: I distinguish between having authority and being authoritarian. A child needs rules, but fear does not help them understand those rules. I prefer a firm approach with explanations that prepares them for independence.
c90be76b202f856f7b8ee7253e4a8c70f358b420.french: Je distingue avoir de l'autorité et être autoritaire. Un enfant a besoin de règles, mais la peur ne l'aide pas à les comprendre. Je préfère une attitude ferme et expliquée, qui prépare son autonomie.
c90be76b202f856f7b8ee7253e4a8c70f358b420.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

c92c3486f657493ad1b8ae40a57782bfbd01382c.english: Rules first help children learn to live with others.
c92c3486f657493ad1b8ae40a57782bfbd01382c.french: Les règles servent d'abord à apprendre à vivre avec les autres.
c92c3486f657493ad1b8ae40a57782bfbd01382c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ca86de2f1e1a833362a7bcff682b85e64341e428.french: L'enfant apprend ainsi à profiter de son jeu tout en tenant compte du repos de quelqu'un d'autre.
ca86de2f1e1a833362a7bcff682b85e64341e428.english: The child thus learns to enjoy his game while taking someone else's rest into account.
ca86de2f1e1a833362a7bcff682b85e64341e428.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

cb01a8229636bdd51586e5df2b68fd153525c0f1.english: First, parents must set rules that the child cannot yet choose alone.
cb01a8229636bdd51586e5df2b68fd153525c0f1.french: D'abord, les parents doivent fixer des règles que l'enfant ne peut pas encore choisir seul.
cb01a8229636bdd51586e5df2b68fd153525c0f1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d67486fa093d66ce982ad3d4fd529a9adfca8d74.english: The limit therefore does not simply depend on the parent's mood.
d67486fa093d66ce982ad3d4fd529a9adfca8d74.french: La limite ne dépend donc pas simplement de l'humeur du parent.
d67486fa093d66ce982ad3d4fd529a9adfca8d74.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d8ea14a314fcffb24e06d5ecc93c5f279da8cb00.french: Par exemple, un enfant qui a abîmé un livre de bibliothèque peut le cacher dans son cartable, de peur de la réaction de ses parents. S'il pouvait en parler sans être humilié, ils pourraient chercher ensemble comment réparer ou remplacer le livre.
d8ea14a314fcffb24e06d5ecc93c5f279da8cb00.english: For example, a child who has damaged a library book may hide it in their schoolbag for fear of their parents' reaction. If they could talk about it without being humiliated, they could work together to find out how to repair or replace it.
d8ea14a314fcffb24e06d5ecc93c5f279da8cb00.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the independently reviewed Famille response and user-provided reference; existing translation history is retained. No provider call was made.

dcd70602425b5a3c7a4924deceec5fa002b35e28.french: Tout d'abord, des règles expliquées aident l'enfant à respecter les besoins des autres.
dcd70602425b5a3c7a4924deceec5fa002b35e28.english: First, explained rules help children respect other people's needs.
dcd70602425b5a3c7a4924deceec5fa002b35e28.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

e3b804f576f926328d19a3be6aa4142cbf633090.french: Je suis pour des règles claires, mais pas pour une éducation fondée sur la peur. Pour moi, les parents doivent pouvoir expliquer leurs décisions et écouter l'enfant sans renoncer à poser des limites. L'important, c'est de lui apprendre à comprendre ses actes, pas seulement à obéir.
e3b804f576f926328d19a3be6aa4142cbf633090.english: I favour clear rules, but not an upbringing based on fear. To me, parents should be able to explain their decisions and listen to their child while still setting limits. What matters is teaching children to understand their actions, not just to obey.
e3b804f576f926328d19a3be6aa4142cbf633090.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

ea8e12eea26dfce0029038dcb6db20004408746c.english: I distinguish between having authority and being authoritarian. A child needs limits for their safety and for living with others. But fear can prevent them talking about their mistakes. I therefore support firm, explained authority that also prepares them for independence.
ea8e12eea26dfce0029038dcb6db20004408746c.french: Je distingue avoir de l'autorité et être autoritaire. Un enfant a besoin de limites pour sa sécurité et la vie commune. Mais la peur peut l'empêcher de parler de ses erreurs. Je suis donc pour une autorité ferme et expliquée, qui prépare aussi à l'autonomie.
ea8e12eea26dfce0029038dcb6db20004408746c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

eb107267c9f9c4fa98edfebaf8cf31d88445810a.english: If every mistake leads to shouting or disproportionate punishment, the child mainly tries not to get caught. Parents may no longer know what is happening and lose opportunities to help.
eb107267c9f9c4fa98edfebaf8cf31d88445810a.french: Si chaque erreur provoque des cris ou une punition disproportionnée, l'enfant cherche surtout à ne pas se faire prendre. Les parents risquent de ne plus savoir ce qui se passe et perdent des occasions de l'aider.
eb107267c9f9c4fa98edfebaf8cf31d88445810a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ed47cf3c0a78f85e83dd2c43b5bcc60b630eb274.english: At home, everyone must be considerate of others’ sleep and activities. Parents can set a clear rule and remind their children of it calmly, rather than only stepping in when they are angry.
ed47cf3c0a78f85e83dd2c43b5bcc60b630eb274.french: À la maison, chacun doit tenir compte du sommeil et des activités des autres. Le parent peut poser une règle compréhensible et la rappeler calmement, plutôt que de n'intervenir que lorsqu'il est en colère.

ed70f07d965b45d84c191db4ba2b616f3bb0cd30.english: Listening does not mean negotiating everything. Near a road, you must intervene immediately if a child puts themselves in danger, even if it means explaining afterwards. Discussion is important, but must not prevent the parent ensuring the child's safety.
ed70f07d965b45d84c191db4ba2b616f3bb0cd30.french: Écouter ne signifie pas tout négocier. Près d'une route, il faut intervenir immédiatement si l'enfant se met en danger, quitte à expliquer après. La discussion est importante, mais elle ne doit pas empêcher le parent d'assurer sa sécurité.
ed70f07d965b45d84c191db4ba2b616f3bb0cd30.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f6f835b9b9a957e4d3b198070a371701729624ca.english: They learn to plan ahead and keep a commitment, even when their parents are not deciding for them.
f6f835b9b9a957e4d3b198070a371701729624ca.french: Il apprend à anticiper et à tenir un engagement, même quand ses parents ne décident pas à sa place.
f6f835b9b9a957e4d3b198070a371701729624ca.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f7d65caa9792a3c631f134bdfd498aa3ddad8c52.english: A teenage boy suggests starting his homework at 5 pm. His mother agrees on condition that it is finished before dinner. A week later, he is keeping to this schedule without her having to remind him.
f7d65caa9792a3c631f134bdfd498aa3ddad8c52.french: Un adolescent propose de commencer ses devoirs à dix-sept heures. Sa mère accepte à condition qu'ils soient finis avant le dîner. Une semaine plus tard, il tient cet horaire sans qu'elle ait à le lui rappeler.
f7d65caa9792a3c631f134bdfd498aa3ddad8c52.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

fe4de583fb6bc1c5c9da83311e0edbc1079f39a4.english: First and foremost, children need clear rules to learn how to live with others.
fe4de583fb6bc1c5c9da83311e0edbc1079f39a4.french: Tout d'abord, les enfants ont besoin de règles claires pour apprendre à vivre avec les autres.

061689d176b2c2bacd626aaffb81f0a193ba53e6.english: Grandparents or cousins do not necessarily speak the host country's language. If every conversation requires translation, talking about your day or sharing a memory becomes difficult. The child needs these opportunities for conversation.
061689d176b2c2bacd626aaffb81f0a193ba53e6.french: Les grands-parents ou les cousins ne parlent pas forcément la langue du pays d'accueil. Si chaque échange exige une traduction, raconter sa journée ou partager un souvenir devient difficile. L'enfant a besoin de ces occasions de dialogue.
061689d176b2c2bacd626aaffb81f0a193ba53e6.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

1044eb944d3aeeb50688e3acfa94d5c198fb2781.english: On the teacher’s advice, parents enrol their child in a workshop at the library. Whilst making a puppet, the child learns to ask for paper and to follow instructions in the local language.
1044eb944d3aeeb50688e3acfa94d5c198fb2781.french: Sur les conseils de l'enseignant, des parents inscrivent leur enfant à un atelier de la bibliothèque. En fabriquant une marionnette, il apprend à demander du papier et à suivre des consignes dans la langue locale.

14847f420be24de5f89aca74780b4d59308a0d42.english: In this way, the child discovers family memories whilst learning words that they can use again.
14847f420be24de5f89aca74780b4d59308a0d42.french: L'enfant découvre ainsi des souvenirs familiaux tout en apprenant des mots qu'il pourra réutiliser.

158d8d06fe7f9d895ff54447d6e4b819aa2fcc87.english: Speaking a common language allows children to participate directly in conversations, without translation always being necessary. They can ask their own questions and seek clarification on anything they haven’t understood.
158d8d06fe7f9d895ff54447d6e4b819aa2fcc87.french: Parler une langue commune permet de participer directement aux conversations, sans qu'une traduction soit toujours nécessaire. On peut poser ses propres questions et demander des précisions sur ce qu'on n'a pas compris.

15a7afcdceb6cc23436217c31100495c60553dc7.english: The child can participate more fully in local life without giving up family conversations.
15a7afcdceb6cc23436217c31100495c60553dc7.french: L'enfant peut mieux participer à la vie locale sans renoncer aux échanges familiaux.

b6c608c3a837cf7e16e4a944ccf10f2751a68939.english: The child makes progress in the local language while continuing to use the family language at home.

bd90413b3ade6cf5d0373500fee3ed86593f2d5a.english: I wouldn’t choose one language over the other. I would make room for the mother tongue in family interactions, whilst helping the children to learn the language of the host country.

d99f8b51b23eaf70e4943e1a067ca00b7947ea8a.french: Cependant, on n'est pas obligé de parler une langue uniquement à la maison et l'autre à l'école. Le bilinguisme parfait n'est pas garanti. L'important est d'encourager l'enfant à parler, sans lui faire honte quand il cherche un mot.

de6b83d4e8998ce0584d68292e1f71ea33e2ff27.english: Outside lessons, the child needs opportunities to listen and respond. Parents can arrange these even if they still speak little of this language. A regular activity allows the child to encounter the same words and people again.

e7cefbba58776fc2b81974cc26e8b13c00c0a490.english: Finally, practising the local language helps the child to participate in the life of the country.

eb90c3885466e1abc1e3aeddd04a35c95b3a0c5f.english: First, the parents' language allows direct communication with family living elsewhere.
eb90c3885466e1abc1e3aeddd04a35c95b3a0c5f.french: D'abord, la langue des parents permet de communiquer directement avec la famille restée ailleurs.

f51e85c768968534659e330b9603fd0e92e48d6c.french: Les grands-parents ne parlent pas forcément la langue du pays d'accueil. f56eaad261dd2272966dc77cb7f7a2bfd2dd5a94.english: The child takes part in the game more easily and gains confidence in speaking, without their parents having to teach them everything.
f56eaad261dd2272966dc77cb7f7a2bfd2dd5a94.french: Il participe plus facilement au jeu et prend confiance pour parler, sans que ses parents aient à tout lui enseigner.
f56eaad261dd2272966dc77cb7f7a2bfd2dd5a94.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f6dc86c451337848b9c687f262fabe34bdb46fbf.english: But there is no obligation to reserve one language for home and the other for school. 0350e9bb995b948bd33322d962039a3b1f5324eb.english: Everyday household skills are learned through practice. A parent first shows the child what to do, then guides them through their first attempts. By repeating the task with less and less help, the child learns to do it alone.
0350e9bb995b948bd33322d962039a3b1f5324eb.french: Les gestes du quotidien s'apprennent avec de la pratique. Un parent montre d'abord comment faire, puis guide l'enfant pendant ses premiers essais. En répétant la tâche avec de moins en moins d'aide, l'enfant apprend à la faire seul.
0350e9bb995b948bd33322d962039a3b1f5324eb.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

03fff20f8097502e66eea75cc51cef21c36c0e41.english: Furthermore, taking part helps people learn useful skills for living independently.
03fff20f8097502e66eea75cc51cef21c36c0e41.french: Ensuite, participer permet d'apprendre des gestes utiles pour vivre de manière autonome.

07340f7dc908d9a7d9e7d0ea5619215ab0c7c77d.french: Prenons l'exemple d'un adolescent qui apprend à faire une lessive. Son parent lui montre comment trier le linge et choisir le programme de lavage, puis l'accompagne pendant plusieurs essais, jusqu'à ce qu'il puisse laver ses vêtements sans aide.
07340f7dc908d9a7d9e7d0ea5619215ab0c7c77d.english: Take a teenager learning to do laundry. The parent shows him how to sort the clothes and choose the wash programme, then guides him through several attempts until he can wash his clothes without help.
07340f7dc908d9a7d9e7d0ea5619215ab0c7c77d.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

0734632de0a0033c7b52d0b4336f2558557271b6.english: First and foremost, sharing tasks prevents one person from having to do all the work for everyone else.
0734632de0a0033c7b52d0b4336f2558557271b6.french: Tout d'abord, partager les tâches évite qu'une seule personne se fatigue pour tout le monde.

09bb6b5bc7943c54abed20c57a953c21a64c90e2.english: When no one knows who is responsible for a particular task, everyone may assume that someone else will do it. Allocating responsibilities – including checking what is missing – means people can take action without having to wait for reminders from a single person.
09bb6b5bc7943c54abed20c57a953c21a64c90e2.french: Quand personne ne sait qui s'occupe d'une tâche, chacun peut croire que l'autre va la faire. Répartir les responsabilités, y compris vérifier ce qui manque, permet d'agir sans attendre les rappels d'une seule personne.

0b7bfe5a2ddcb10182e2f9b192763d814c187c12.french: Bien sûr, participer ne veut pas dire faire tous la même chose. Un petit enfant peut ranger ses jouets, tandis qu'une personne malade peut être dispensée de tâches. Il faut regarder ce que chacun peut réellement faire.
0b7bfe5a2ddcb10182e2f9b192763d814c187c12.english: Of course, taking part does not mean everyone doing the same thing. A small child can put away their toys, while someone who is ill can be excused from chores. We need to consider what everyone can actually do.
0b7bfe5a2ddcb10182e2f9b192763d814c187c12.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

10a0c56e81a3754dd00d1f531ea6174e7717a837.english: Two parents get home from work at 6 pm. One prepares dinner while the other lays the table, then does the washing-up. After the meal, each has finished their share and can rest.
10a0c56e81a3754dd00d1f531ea6174e7717a837.french: Deux parents rentrent du travail à dix-huit heures. L'un prépare le dîner pendant que l'autre met la table, puis fait la vaisselle. Après le repas, chacun a terminé sa part et peut se reposer.
10a0c56e81a3754dd00d1f531ea6174e7717a837.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

10faa9dc699f2b914fec1d28fe03ba9636496def.english: Next, contributing teaches children to look after themselves.

10faa9dc699f2b914fec1d28fe03ba9636496def.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

11fdde4853efc33a815a6129ac3e83d062fe64a9.english: Finally, a clear system of organisation prevents things from being overlooked and avoids arguments about what each person is supposed to do.
11fdde4853efc33a815a6129ac3e83d062fe64a9.french: Enfin, une organisation claire évite les oublis et les disputes sur ce que chacun doit faire.

171090dd8b35188c8c4c96da0489a02ee4279549.english: Yes, everyone in the household should do their share of the chores, according to their abilities. Keeping the home clean and organising everyday tasks should not fall to just one person.
171090dd8b35188c8c4c96da0489a02ee4279549.french: Oui, chaque membre du foyer devrait participer aux tâches selon ses possibilités. Le ménage et l'organisation du quotidien ne devraient pas reposer sur une seule personne.

229c1962fd3443c8f8b653b0e0862c04889f6773.french: Enfin, se mettre d'accord sur les tâches peut éviter bien des tensions à la maison.
229c1962fd3443c8f8b653b0e0862c04889f6773.english: Finally, agreeing on chores can prevent a lot of tension at home.

2af9ae67af72cb528bc46d5cc09e0edff54e439b.english: For example, a parent shows their teenage son how to sort laundry and choose the wash programme. The teenager then does several loads under the parent's supervision. Once he feels comfortable doing it, he washes his clothes without needing help.

2cd57de220d119fd19637adc2717c483e0efcec5.french: Cet accord peut réduire les rappels et les disputes, parce que chacun connaît sa responsabilité.

37f32d03db210a4241a24c0e7bc52a8d6bac298d.english: For children, contributing also prepares them for independence.

3a9623c78c4222f67dc3f04468fb8a67943cef1d.french: D'abord, partager les tâches est une question de justice.
3a9623c78c4222f67dc3f04468fb8a67943cef1d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

45be281d64a669d8ee31873f171ce4cbf59ee79a.english: Both keep some free time: one person's rest no longer depends on the other's work.
45be281d64a669d8ee31873f171ce4cbf59ee79a.french: Les deux gardent du temps libre : le repos de l'un ne dépend plus du travail de l'autre.
45be281d64a669d8ee31873f171ce4cbf59ee79a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

482bb7eeef7af728c0170eab0d6e676053323dc0.french: Après une journée de travail ou d'études, tout le monde a besoin de souffler. Pourtant, si une seule personne doit encore cuisiner, nettoyer et s'occuper du linge, elle continue à travailler pendant que les autres se reposent. 482bb7eeef7af728c0170eab0d6e676053323dc0.english: After a day of work or study, everyone needs a breather. Yet if one person still has to cook, clean and deal with laundry, they keep working while the others rest. Dividing chores means recognising that their time matters just as much as anyone else's.

49711c288903e79f80550a1e5556cefa9f9391d5.french: Savoir laver ses vêtements ou préparer un repas ne vient pas automatiquement avec l'âge. 49711c288903e79f80550a1e5556cefa9f9391d5.english: Knowing how to wash your clothes or prepare a meal does not come automatically with age. These are skills we learn by watching, trying and doing them again. By guiding children at first, parents gradually give them the means to manage alone.
49711c288903e79f80550a1e5556cefa9f9391d5.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

49bb22939b748ddf20b59144179a7b58d6a045d3.english: Sharing the workload can therefore give everyone time to rest.
49bb22939b748ddf20b59144179a7b58d6a045d3.french: Le partage peut ainsi laisser à chacun du temps pour se reposer.

4fce9d4fc4e66b1b9195ea3102e5e9d08ad5d583.french: Oui, je pense que tous les membres du foyer devraient participer aux tâches ménagères, selon leurs possibilités. Puisque chacun profite d'une maison propre et de repas préparés, il me semble normal que ce travail ne repose pas toujours sur la même personne.
4fce9d4fc4e66b1b9195ea3102e5e9d08ad5d583.english: Yes, I think all household members should take part in chores according to their abilities. Since everyone benefits from a clean home and prepared meals, it seems normal to me that this work should not always fall to the same person.
4fce9d4fc4e66b1b9195ea3102e5e9d08ad5d583.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

52a8363c9a76b362a4ff6ea7a487bb18e07bb84a.english: Everyone benefits from meals and clean laundry. If one person takes care of it all, the others rest while that person works. Contributing is therefore not doing them a favour, but taking your share of responsibility for living together.
52a8363c9a76b362a4ff6ea7a487bb18e07bb84a.french: Tout le monde profite des repas et du linge propre. Si une seule personne s'en occupe, les autres se reposent pendant qu'elle travaille. Participer n'est donc pas lui rendre service, mais assumer sa part de la vie commune.
52a8363c9a76b362a4ff6ea7a487bb18e07bb84a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

53b2f3616f8f4234ca328645de1a4c7012d7f783.english: You do not know how to manage a home simply because you reach a certain age. You need to learn to cook, wash clothes and put away the equipment you have used. Parents demonstrate, then let children try with appropriate responsibilities.
53b2f3616f8f4234ca328645de1a4c7012d7f783.french: On ne sait pas gérer un logement simplement parce qu'on atteint un certain âge. Il faut apprendre à cuisiner, laver le linge et ranger le matériel utilisé. Les parents montrent les gestes, puis laissent essayer avec des responsabilités adaptées.
53b2f3616f8f4234ca328645de1a4c7012d7f783.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

56d278d5b10e6a1ee8c082357f9074148b32d6d8.english: Finally, a clear division of chores can reduce arguments at home.
56d278d5b10e6a1ee8c082357f9074148b32d6d8.french: Enfin, une répartition claire des tâches peut réduire les disputes à la maison.
56d278d5b10e6a1ee8c082357f9074148b32d6d8.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

572622dfd97780f2be0f514966c752c9f70e2bef.english: A teenager can learn to sort the laundry and select the wash cycle with an adult. After several supervised attempts, they can take charge of a wash, rather than only discovering how to use the machine on the day they leave home.
572622dfd97780f2be0f514966c752c9f70e2bef.french: Un adolescent peut apprendre à trier le linge et à choisir le programme de lavage avec un adulte. Après plusieurs essais accompagnés, il peut prendre en charge une lessive, plutôt que découvrir la machine seulement le jour où il quitte le domicile familial.

594cb6700eab8b98f52382baf0cf87d2fa90ccb1.english: In a couple, one person takes charge of household cleaning products. They check the stock and buy more before they run out. The other person can then do the washing without having to stop what they’re doing to go to the shop.

6bce674d8f4eae9c17117480b037e61ac6192a9b.english: That said, I understand criticism of someone who refuses to contribute when they have the means to do so. But this behaviour does not represent all young people living with their family. No single age for leaving home suits every situation.
6bce674d8f4eae9c17117480b037e61ac6192a9b.french: Cela dit, je comprends les critiques envers quelqu'un qui refuse de contribuer alors qu'il en a les moyens. Mais ce comportement ne représente pas tous les jeunes qui vivent en famille. Aucun âge de départ ne convient à toutes les situations.

70c6c09409477208ab8e7f91056ba6132f9e9e0d.french: À mon avis, on ne peut pas juger trop vite ces jeunes adultes canadiens qui restent chez leurs parents parce qu'ils s'y sentent bien. a209d927e5614766c0d01b7c157a97532fc263a9.french: Bien sûr, le coût du logement peut aussi compter dans ce choix. Et si l'entente est difficile ou que l'on manque de place, vivre séparément peut être préférable. Aucun âge de départ ne convient à toutes les familles.

2a3d7ffa6091dfced0fe4c5c0b941103511864e3.english: So yes, we should be honest with children, but also reassure them. What matters is explaining what is happening in simple words suited to their age.

2e67f46736f06c0382efb94a2169374fcdd7d44d.english: In conclusion, I would opt for an honest, gradual and caring approach. A truthful explanation helps children to understand and maintain trust, without them becoming the adults’ confidants.

3662d6bd01d24d1960f0d48e804dd27ba375fc77.english: However, children do not need to know about every conflict or every detail of adults’ private lives. You can tell them that a question is personal or that you do not yet have an answer. Being honest does not mean telling them everything.
3662d6bd01d24d1960f0d48e804dd27ba375fc77.french: Cependant, l'enfant n'a pas à connaître tous les conflits ou tous les détails de la vie privée des adultes. On peut lui dire qu'une question est personnelle ou qu'on n'a pas encore de réponse. Être honnête, ce n'est pas tout lui raconter.

ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.french: Avant de jouer du piano devant la classe, il demande s'il est prêt. On peut répondre : « Tu connais bien le début, mais tu hésites à la fin. On peut la reprendre ensemble. »
ae929e8bfbff5c7c36c8c48cf1b0f02fa8a165f5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b2b044520796dc20d2fe0894842e4e039a08a896.french: La fillette comprend mieux cette absence et peut garder le contact, au lieu de rester seule avec son inquiétude.
b2b044520796dc20d2fe0894842e4e039a08a896.english: The little girl understands the absence better and can keep in touch, rather than being left alone with her worries.
b2b044520796dc20d2fe0894842e4e039a08a896.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.english: For me, it is better to tell children a simple truth than to invent a story to avoid a difficult conversation. Honesty maintains trust and helps them understand what they are going through. But it does not mean telling them everything as though they were adults.
b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.french: Pour moi, il vaut mieux dire une vérité simple aux enfants qu'inventer une histoire pour éviter une conversation difficile. L'honnêteté entretient la confiance et les aide à comprendre ce qu'ils vivent. Mais elle ne signifie pas tout raconter comme à un adulte.
b52a625efeda41e5758dfaf5e684efad963c7b3b.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.english: They hear an argument or see a parent crying. Without an explanation, they may invent an answer and believe they are responsible. The truth must therefore be adapted to their age, with simple words and time for their questions.
b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.french: Ils entendent une dispute ou voient un parent pleurer. Sans explication, ils peuvent inventer une réponse et se croire responsables. Il faut donc que la vérité soit adaptée à leur âge, avec des mots simples et du temps pour leurs questions.
b82ddbfb60940b13959769b313f936433e6c4c0f.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b9ae8e6e26cf53d252621760ca99bb37795779de.english: I believe we should prioritise the truth with children, but ‘always’ does not mean telling them everything straight away. You can be honest without giving all the details. The key is to choose words appropriate to the child’s age and to address what they need to understand.
b9ae8e6e26cf53d252621760ca99bb37795779de.french: Je pense qu'il faut privilégier la vérité avec les enfants, mais « toujours » ne signifie pas tout raconter immédiatement. On peut être honnête sans donner tous les détails. L'essentiel est de choisir des mots adaptés à l'âge de l'enfant et de répondre à ce qu'il a besoin de comprendre.

c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.english: Encouragement does not mean saying everything is perfect. A child can hear that they still need to work on something if their efforts are recognised and someone explains how to do it. A difficulty is not a judgement of their worth.
c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.french: Encourager ne signifie pas dire que tout est parfait. Un enfant peut entendre qu'il doit encore travailler quelque chose si on reconnaît ses efforts et lui explique comment faire. Une difficulté n'est pas un jugement sur sa valeur.
c81d74178c250bc6aa6b74b59c6863894a187117.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ca21d49e610b235e4a18ca92efe5bbd50e90d05e.french: Les enfants remarquent les absences, les silences et les habitudes qui changent, même quand les adultes essaient de les protéger. Sans explication, ils peuvent inventer une raison plus inquiétante que la réalité. Il faut donc que la vérité soit adaptée à leur âge, avec du temps pour écouter leurs questions.
ca21d49e610b235e4a18ca92efe5bbd50e90d05e.english: Children notice absences, silences and changing routines, even when adults are trying to protect them. Without an explanation, they may invent a reason more worrying than the reality. The truth must therefore be adapted to their age, with time to listen to their questions.
ca21d49e610b235e4a18ca92efe5bbd50e90d05e.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.english: However, a child should not have to carry the burden of adults' relationship conflicts or financial worries. You can explain a restriction without asking them to solve the problem. And it is better to acknowledge uncertainty than to promise an outcome that is unknown.
ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.french: Cependant, l'enfant n'a pas à porter les conflits de couple ou les inquiétudes financières des adultes. On peut expliquer une restriction sans lui demander de résoudre le problème. Et mieux vaut reconnaître une incertitude que promettre une issue inconnue.
ceb8b940c75168d599bb8f734fe5a9bae4f48927.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d3feb0fa585358e09139fc13c53f474dd9dfc292.english: If an adult makes up a reason that is easy to refute, the child may subsequently doubt their explanations. When their words remain trustworthy, the child can ask them questions without wondering whether they are hiding the real reason.
d3feb0fa585358e09139fc13c53f474dd9dfc292.french: Si l'adulte invente une raison facile à contredire, l'enfant peut ensuite douter de ses explications. Quand ses paroles restent fiables, l'enfant peut lui poser des questions sans se demander s'il cache la vraie raison.

d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.english: A false promise reassures them for a few moments, but may make them doubt the next explanation. An honest answer gives them something to rely on, even when it is not pleasant to hear.
d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.french: Une fausse promesse le rassure quelques instants, mais peut lui faire douter de la prochaine explication. Une réponse honnête lui donne un repère, même lorsqu'elle n'est pas agréable à entendre.
d8afd6cd9b7c10f9f324cbef72556b681c2941e1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.english: They know what to expect and can see afterwards that the adult explained things accurately.
df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.french: Il sait à quoi s'attendre et constate ensuite que l'adulte lui avait expliqué les choses correctement.
df6f133bcb9bd8c41228a76ee86ed14c339cdd43.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

eaceda664f31f946b1fa5e41bd75eacf311964a9.english: First and foremost, an honest explanation helps the child to trust the adult.
eaceda664f31f946b1fa5e41bd75eacf311964a9.french: Tout d'abord, une explication honnête aide l'enfant à faire confiance à l'adulte.

ec27f40f08c4ade66b142c1fdd473cb1ddebb53e.french: Prenons l'exemple d'une fillette qui ne voit plus sa grand-mère le mercredi. Ses parents peuvent expliquer qu'elle est à l'hôpital après une chute et organiser un appel, sans promettre qu'elle guérira tout de suite.
ec27f40f08c4ade66b142c1fdd473cb1ddebb53e.english: Take a little girl who no longer sees her grandmother on Wednesdays. Her parents can explain that she is in hospital after a fall and arrange a call, without promising that she will recover straight away.
ec27f40f08c4ade66b142c1fdd473cb1ddebb53e.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

ef981aac9c3398fa1aa03a73c283e35d4d5cc85a.french: L'enfant peut avoir peur de la piqûre tout en gardant confiance dans la personne qui l'accompagne.
ef981aac9c3398fa1aa03a73c283e35d4d5cc85a.english: The child can be afraid of the injection while still trusting the person accompanying them.
ef981aac9c3398fa1aa03a73c283e35d4d5cc85a.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.english: First, a child must be able to believe what their parents tell them.
f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.french: D'abord, l'enfant doit pouvoir croire ce que ses parents lui disent.
f40834257cafb1cf347d27b0e4a859e99c294219.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

ffbe53eb091d5c64373bde4f02c0e16779281210.english: Making up an excuse may ease the child’s mind in the moment, but it does not help them understand their difficulties. The adult can acknowledge what went wrong, then work with the child to find ways to move forward.
ffbe53eb091d5c64373bde4f02c0e16779281210.french: Inventer une excuse peut soulager l'enfant sur le moment, mais cela ne l'aide pas à comprendre ses difficultés. L'adulte peut reconnaître ce qui n'a pas marché, puis chercher avec lui comment progresser.

01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.english: The bond still exists, but takes more effort and sometimes leaves them feeling on the sidelines of family life.
01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.french: Le lien existe toujours, mais demande davantage d'efforts et laisse parfois le sentiment d'être à côté de la vie familiale.
01c06f6891c8b7263618652dcc5a20c014fc85ba.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

0687b3ac07c806f83917fb3b4a2905045d7eaaa9.french: Tout d'abord, les échanges à distance ne remplacent pas tous les moments partagés.
0687b3ac07c806f83917fb3b4a2905045d7eaaa9.english: First, keeping in touch from a distance does not replace every shared moment.
0687b3ac07c806f83917fb3b4a2905045d7eaaa9.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

09084dda2a043714628674533ab1bd23d126b504.english: A daughter lives eight hours away from her father by train. To come for his birthday, she would need two days' leave and a ticket beyond her budget. She gives up the visit.
09084dda2a043714628674533ab1bd23d126b504.french: Une fille vit à huit heures de train de son père. Pour venir à son anniversaire, elle aurait besoin de deux jours de congé et d'un billet trop cher pour son budget. Elle renonce à la visite.
09084dda2a043714628674533ab1bd23d126b504.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

13009f665d39480da0169fac06a7122afb1d8acc.english: Someone living on their own might ring their family on a Sunday, only to find themselves eating dinner alone once the call has ended. The call allows them to catch up with their loved ones, but it cannot replace the meal they used to share with them.
13009f665d39480da0169fac06a7122afb1d8acc.french: Une personne installée seule peut appeler sa famille le dimanche, puis dîner sans compagnie une fois la conversation terminée. L'appel lui permet de prendre des nouvelles, mais ne remplace pas le repas qu'elle partageait avec ses proches.

1401b27796582af721c43023cddf8fe15c86c23a.french: En effet, vivre près des siens permet de passer prendre un café, de discuter après un repas ou de se voir sans tout organiser. À distance, les appels maintiennent le lien, mais ils ne donnent pas accès à toute cette vie ordinaire. On peut être au courant des nouvelles et avoir malgré tout le sentiment de manquer quelque chose.
1401b27796582af721c43023cddf8fe15c86c23a.english: Living near your family lets you drop in for coffee, talk after a meal or see one another without organising everything. At a distance, calls maintain the bond, but do not give you access to all this everyday life. You can know the news and still feel that you are missing something.
1401b27796582af721c43023cddf8fe15c86c23a.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

17f787362c8f97dad939530100442a39ca9e4e21.english: You need to find time, plan the journey and pay for the ticket. Wanting to be there is therefore not always enough. Even an event planned well in advance may fall at a time when these constraints are too great.
17f787362c8f97dad939530100442a39ca9e4e21.french: Il faut trouver du temps, prévoir le trajet et payer le billet. La volonté d'être présent ne suffit donc pas toujours. Même un événement prévu longtemps à l'avance peut tomber à un moment où ces contraintes sont trop fortes.
17f787362c8f97dad939530100442a39ca9e4e21.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

19fe70afe8cb531c01a7bf1e474d993699822196.english: Being far away can therefore sometimes add to the organisational challenges, quite apart from the feeling of missing loved ones.
19fe70afe8cb531c01a7bf1e474d993699822196.french: L'éloignement ajoute donc parfois une difficulté d'organisation, au-delà du sentiment de manque.

1d343353af9bd55491e4d20dc8955cd5d1901b63.french: Par exemple, une personne peut appeler sa famille chaque dimanche et ressentir pourtant un pincement au cœur en voyant la photo d'un repas improvisé chez sa sœur. Ce qui lui manque, c'est de pouvoir être là spontanément, pas seulement de recevoir des nouvelles.
1d343353af9bd55491e4d20dc8955cd5d1901b63.english: For example, someone can call their family every Sunday and still feel a pang on seeing a photograph of an impromptu meal at their sister's home. What they miss is being able to be there spontaneously, not just receiving news.
1d343353af9bd55491e4d20dc8955cd5d1901b63.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

1f5104e0ee845c23a4d149517ce5a703ab90bb32.english: A parent finishes work too late to collect his child. Before moving, he relied on the grandparents. This time, he calls a trusted neighbour whom he has already authorised with the school to collect the child.
1f5104e0ee845c23a4d149517ce5a703ab90bb32.french: Un parent finit son travail trop tard pour récupérer son enfant. Avant de déménager, il comptait sur les grands-parents. Cette fois, il appelle une voisine de confiance qu'il a déjà autorisée auprès de l'école.
1f5104e0ee845c23a4d149517ce5a703ab90bb32.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2756dff8749ba81787c86ca43fa4c3096a79b513.english: Loved ones can offer advice from a distance without being able to travel to see you or provide immediate assistance. You therefore need to find other sources of support and plan ahead more carefully for certain situations.
2756dff8749ba81787c86ca43fa4c3096a79b513.french: Les proches peuvent conseiller à distance sans pouvoir faire un déplacement ou rendre un service immédiat. Il faut alors qu'on trouve d'autres appuis et qu'on prévoie davantage certaines situations.

2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.english: Family can listen and give advice over the phone, but cannot always help in practical ways. At first, you do not necessarily know someone you can ask for a favour. It is therefore important to know who to call when something unexpected happens.
2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.french: La famille peut écouter et conseiller au téléphone, mais pas toujours intervenir concrètement. Au début, on ne connaît pas forcément quelqu'un à qui demander un service. Il est donc important qu'on sache qui appeler en cas d'imprévu.
2a3c91eb32fea52ca662918a4fbe8966dab36ce3.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.deepl_english: Loved ones can offer advice from afar without being able to travel to see you or provide immediate assistance. You therefore need to find other sources of support locally and know who to call in the event of an emergency.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.english: People close to us can offer advice from a distance without being able to make a journey or provide immediate help. We then need to find other support locally and know who to call when something unexpected happens.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.french: Les proches peuvent conseiller à distance sans pouvoir faire un déplacement ou rendre un service immédiat. Il faut alors qu'on trouve d'autres appuis sur place et qu'on sache qui appeler en cas d'imprévu.
2bc5b37cf1ba625230bc94c180e790716825f247.review_note: An imprévu can be an unexpected scheduling problem, not an emergency; the unavailable journey need not be a visit to the speaker.

3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.english: Someone living abroad calls their family every Sunday. Yet, seeing a photo of an impromptu meal at their sister's home, they realise that this moment happened without them.
3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.french: Une personne installée à l'étranger appelle sa famille chaque dimanche. Pourtant, en voyant une photo du repas improvisé chez sa sœur, elle réalise que ce moment s'est passé sans elle.
3f770f42d0bb068e361bec96a1f82c97c3b258ed.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

40b08266025ed82c4140f29af4770b6db3c1426d.english: In conclusion, living far from one’s family isn’t necessarily easy: you have to cope with missing them, find support locally and plan visits. Phone calls and the connections you build with those around you can help, though they cannot replace all those moments spent with family.
40b08266025ed82c4140f29af4770b6db3c1426d.french: En conclusion, vivre loin de sa famille n'est pas forcément facile : il faut gérer le manque, trouver de l'aide sur place et prévoir les visites. Les appels et les liens qu'on crée autour de soi peuvent aider, sans remplacer tous les moments en famille.

40f3ddede5c43dd140151c748aa5deb3f17877e0.english: A woman lives and works an eight-hour train journey from her father's home. To celebrate his birthday with him, she would need to take two days off work. She also cannot afford the train ticket, so she decides not to make the trip.
40f3ddede5c43dd140151c748aa5deb3f17877e0.french: Une femme vit et travaille à huit heures de train de chez son père. Pour fêter son anniversaire avec lui, elle devrait prendre deux jours de congé. Le billet dépasse aussi son budget : elle renonce donc à la visite.
40f3ddede5c43dd140151c748aa5deb3f17877e0.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

4593dd77fe177a78026df2ae17f4079bdeaa73e4.english: Finally, the distance can make it difficult to organise reunions.
4593dd77fe177a78026df2ae17f4079bdeaa73e4.french: Enfin, la distance peut rendre les retrouvailles difficiles à organiser.

48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.english: Living far from your family takes real adjustment. You miss everyday moments, immediate help is no longer available and getting together takes planning. That does not mean regretting your move: you can love your new life while still missing your loved ones.
48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.french: Vivre loin de sa famille demande une vraie adaptation. Les moments ordinaires manquent, l'aide immédiate n'est plus disponible et les retrouvailles demandent une organisation. Cela ne signifie pas regretter son départ : on peut aimer sa nouvelle vie tout en ressentant le manque de ses proches.
48ad61f3e78c982c0899e32d454f72f1cf440d31.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.english: Next, you need to rebuild a support network close to home.
4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.french: Ensuite, il faut reconstruire un réseau d'entraide près de chez soi.
4a2efc478b643ba6125114dc99560e0a4eaf4b91.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

51c3755b1528e03513c0b1e2c1ae5ab3c215eaa9.french: Un appel lui permet de partager un moment avec lui, mais ne remplace pas complètement le plaisir d'être réunis.
51c3755b1528e03513c0b1e2c1ae5ab3c215eaa9.english: A call lets her share a moment with him, but does not completely replace the pleasure of being together.
51c3755b1528e03513c0b1e2c1ae5ab3c215eaa9.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.english: Finally, distance sometimes prevents you being there when you want to be.
55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.french: Enfin, la distance empêche parfois d'être présent au moment souhaité.
55bc3e09b1b3b7387fb6770b2ecef85c6e3621cc.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

5f8a45acbff758cdea2fb6653a7acc646b1136ef.english: The desire to see one another does not, therefore, eliminate the constraints of time and money.
5f8a45acbff758cdea2fb6653a7acc646b1136ef.french: La volonté de se voir ne supprime donc pas les contraintes de temps et de budget.

643aedda3c703ab76478a72401d0948f2a07fe15.french: À mon avis, on peut construire une vie heureuse loin de sa famille, mais cela ne veut pas dire que la distance soit facile à vivre. Quand on s'entend bien avec ses proches, leur présence peut manquer, aussi bien dans les petits moments du quotidien que dans les situations où l'on a besoin d'aide.
643aedda3c703ab76478a72401d0948f2a07fe15.english: In my view, we can build a happy life far from our family, but that does not mean distance is easy to live with. When we get on well with those close to us, we can miss their presence both in small everyday moments and when we need help.
643aedda3c703ab76478a72401d0948f2a07fe15.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.english: Reliable friends and good relationships with neighbours make daily life more secure, without replacing family.
658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.french: Des amis fiables et de bonnes relations de voisinage rendent le quotidien plus sûr, sans remplacer la famille.
658f8092fbe557741ea81a168051c1b1b5db8284.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.english: First, you may come to miss small family routines.
6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.french: D'abord, les petites habitudes familiales peuvent finir par manquer.
6bfb85140d5b4a3181d22dfa234cef146af7140c.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

6e5f856d5569a747c68ab94413c9148564a905a6.english: First and foremost, being far away can create a sense of emotional longing in everyday life.
6e5f856d5569a747c68ab94413c9148564a905a6.french: Tout d'abord, l'éloignement peut créer un manque affectif au quotidien.

75d7eac64ec6c3667b5c7e9d81878b8a2f2a4f7e.english: Furthermore, certain needs require help that is available locally.
75d7eac64ec6c3667b5c7e9d81878b8a2f2a4f7e.french: Ensuite, certains besoins demandent une aide disponible sur place.

7de9598f25c59520effa375ea41edd46eca772e1.english: She collects the child, but this backup only exists because he arranged it in advance. The family can no longer provide this help at short notice.
7de9598f25c59520effa375ea41edd46eca772e1.french: Elle va chercher l'enfant, mais ce relais n'existe que parce qu'il l'a organisé à l'avance. La famille ne peut plus assurer ce dépannage.
7de9598f25c59520effa375ea41edd46eca772e1.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

8716568b9772ffa4bdd7924d6576d7612c491c8d.english: The emotional sense of missing someone is then compounded by the practical frustration of being unable to be there.
8716568b9772ffa4bdd7924d6576d7612c491c8d.french: Au manque affectif s'ajoute alors la frustration concrète de ne pas pouvoir être là.
8716568b9772ffa4bdd7924d6576d7612c491c8d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

94df459eefcb16040572a67a9708be2fcfa3252d.english: Distance turns a simple visit into a trip that requires planning. Holidays, work schedules and budget constraints can limit the frequency of reunions, even when everyone would like to see each other more often.

970aad08f6151e52d011f26e3577949da706bc98.french: Par exemple, une femme qui travaille à huit heures de train de chez son père voudrait être présente pour son anniversaire. 983daae05222e1333e0b51685ec34f4e0eecbd84.french: Prenons l'exemple d'un parent qui comptait sur les grands-parents pour récupérer son enfant à l'école quand il finissait tard. Une fois installé loin d'eux, il doit trouver une autre personne de confiance ou demander à quitter le travail plus tôt.
983daae05222e1333e0b51685ec34f4e0eecbd84.english: Take a parent who relied on the grandparents to collect their child from school when they finished work late. Once they have moved far away, they have to find another trusted person or ask to leave work earlier.

987c77c08987725f46d42f3bafc1f3abb2baada5.english: Even with regular phone calls, this person may still feel the absence of their family.
987c77c08987725f46d42f3bafc1f3abb2baada5.french: Même avec des appels réguliers, cette personne peut donc ressentir le manque de sa famille.

9a0c362b238fc8c19c62ae55ee6f2fdf1940c26f.french: En conclusion, la distance n'empêche pas le bonheur, mais elle change la manière de vivre les liens familiaux. Garder un contact régulier et préparer les retrouvailles aide à mieux la vivre, sans faire disparaître tout ce qui peut manquer.
9a0c362b238fc8c19c62ae55ee6f2fdf1940c26f.english: In conclusion, distance does not prevent happiness, but changes how we experience family relationships. Keeping in regular contact and planning reunions helps us live with it, without making everything we miss disappear.
9a0c362b238fc8c19c62ae55ee6f2fdf1940c26f.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

9f6250e4cd2cce2e4e768ba66a86d43749ba781b.french: Ce qui se réglait facilement en famille peut alors demander beaucoup plus d'organisation.

9f6250e4cd2cce2e4e768ba66a86d43749ba781b.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

a26a9ba0689ee9090c545f79278b4b9a6b725a09.french: Une personne malade doit récupérer un médicament, alors que ses parents sont à plusieurs heures d'avion. Si elle connaît un voisin disponible, elle pourra peut-être lui demander ce service.
a26a9ba0689ee9090c545f79278b4b9a6b725a09.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

b8ebbfde4496c708f3e68e55e78c9c1c7d1780df.english: A daughter who lives an eight-hour train journey from her parents would like to come home for her father’s birthday.
