Elle devrait poser deux jours de congé et payer un billet qui dépasse son budget. Elle renonce donc à venir, même si elle tient à être présente.

bca46358eadcaf2b3e6564b4a31d4c90c4330d6a.english: When you get on well with your family, I do not think living far from them is easy. You may have chosen to leave and love your new life, while still missing them. Distance also changes very practical aspects of daily life.
bca46358eadcaf2b3e6564b4a31d4c90c4330d6a.french: Quand on s'entend bien avec sa famille, je ne trouve pas facile de vivre loin d'elle. On peut avoir choisi son départ et aimer sa nouvelle vie, tout en ressentant le manque. La distance change aussi des choses très pratiques au quotidien.
bca46358eadcaf2b3e6564b4a31d4c90c4330d6a.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

bec5666a4df61cc259e96f5fa106c9e4eeb39d7b.french: Une visite ne consiste plus simplement à passer chez quelqu'un : il faut prévoir le trajet, payer le billet et parfois prendre congé. Même lorsqu'on tient beaucoup à un événement familial, ces contraintes peuvent empêcher d'y participer.
bec5666a4df61cc259e96f5fa106c9e4eeb39d7b.english: A visit no longer just means dropping in: you have to plan the journey, pay for the ticket and sometimes take leave. Even when a family event means a lot to you, these constraints can prevent you from taking part.
bec5666a4df61cc259e96f5fa106c9e4eeb39d7b.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

bf714b49d958aa16b35fc0f94e926bdf102c8720.french: Enfin, retrouver ses proches demande parfois un vrai budget et du temps disponible.
bf714b49d958aa16b35fc0f94e926bdf102c8720.english: Finally, seeing loved ones sometimes requires a substantial budget and time off.
bf714b49d958aa16b35fc0f94e926bdf102c8720.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

c0fb28f238934362a016ea20407b6c1f7216a46b.french: Bien sûr, la distance peut mieux convenir quand les relations familiales sont difficiles. Un travail intéressant, des amis et une vie locale aident aussi à trouver son équilibre. Vivre loin ne signifie donc pas être malheureux en permanence.
c0fb28f238934362a016ea20407b6c1f7216a46b.english: Of course, distance may suit difficult family relationships better. An interesting job, friends and a local life also help you find a balance. Living far away therefore does not mean being unhappy all the time.
c0fb28f238934362a016ea20407b6c1f7216a46b.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

c3600b4b868768e5f128c9f0efb9c59d6e2451ad.english: If she is unavailable, he has to find another solution, for example asking to leave work early.
c3600b4b868768e5f128c9f0efb9c59d6e2451ad.french: Si elle n'est pas disponible, il doit chercher une autre solution, par exemple demander à quitter le travail plus tôt.
c3600b4b868768e5f128c9f0efb9c59d6e2451ad.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

c8c9adfa3c659337a54f5e102b9cb48a21e9a79d.english: This is not just about missing them emotionally: you also need to find help locally.
c8c9adfa3c659337a54f5e102b9cb48a21e9a79d.french: Ce manque n'est pas seulement affectif : il faut aussi retrouver de l'aide sur place.
c8c9adfa3c659337a54f5e102b9cb48a21e9a79d.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d553d3c609426ad732c26fdd6bbee0d8eadc9861.english: When relationships are good, living far from one’s family can still be difficult. You miss the little moments, practical help is less readily available, and visits take time and money. Nevertheless, it is possible to build a fulfilling life elsewhere.
d553d3c609426ad732c26fdd6bbee0d8eadc9861.french: Quand les relations sont bonnes, vivre loin de sa famille peut être difficile. Les petits moments manquent, l'aide pratique est moins accessible et les visites demandent du temps et de l'argent. On peut néanmoins construire une vie satisfaisante ailleurs.

d6d94e0c3569e863f51c229c30d2176b078b35d4.english: In short, living far from your family is not always simple, but you can still be happy. Regular contact, planned visits and a local life help you find a balance.
d6d94e0c3569e863f51c229c30d2176b078b35d4.french: Bref, vivre loin des siens n'est pas toujours simple, mais reste compatible avec le bonheur. Un contact régulier, des visites préparées et une vie locale aident à trouver son équilibre.
d6d94e0c3569e863f51c229c30d2176b078b35d4.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

db07999bfb98ab437631413677ad5a7fe043dd41.french: Ensuite, l'éloignement se fait aussi sentir quand on a besoin d'un coup de main.
db07999bfb98ab437631413677ad5a7fe043dd41.english: Next, distance also makes itself felt when you need a helping hand.
db07999bfb98ab437631413677ad5a7fe043dd41.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

dc7872ab871a40be43f506238ce5b9cb3cf2976f.english: If a mother is admitted to hospital, her son living abroad may want to come immediately. But the ticket price and the leave he needs to arrange sometimes force him to wait several days.
dc7872ab871a40be43f506238ce5b9cb3cf2976f.french: Si une mère est hospitalisée, son fils vivant à l'étranger peut vouloir venir immédiatement. Mais le prix du billet et les congés à obtenir l'obligent parfois à attendre plusieurs jours.
dc7872ab871a40be43f506238ce5b9cb3cf2976f.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

dd5cd5a1a147a8d71e0973f52e8c3a23f21a31e5.english: That said, choosing to move for a project you care about can be enriching, especially with routines and friendships where you live. You are not necessarily happier near your family when relationships are difficult.
dd5cd5a1a147a8d71e0973f52e8c3a23f21a31e5.french: Cela dit, un départ choisi pour un projet motivant peut être enrichissant, surtout avec des habitudes et des amitiés sur place. On n'est pas forcément plus heureux près de sa famille lorsque les relations sont difficiles.
dd5cd5a1a147a8d71e0973f52e8c3a23f21a31e5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

e3e822ba838ce06e4fca3a96709800b5fd0fcd28.french: La famille peut écouter et conseiller au téléphone, mais elle ne peut pas toujours intervenir concrètement. Après un déménagement, il faut reconstruire un réseau de personnes de confiance. Il est donc important qu'on sache qui appeler en cas d'imprévu, plutôt que compter sur une aide devenue trop lointaine.
e3e822ba838ce06e4fca3a96709800b5fd0fcd28.english: Family can listen and give advice over the phone, but cannot always help in practical ways. After a move, you need to rebuild a network of people you trust. It is therefore important to know who to call when something unexpected happens, rather than relying on help that is now too far away.
e3e822ba838ce06e4fca3a96709800b5fd0fcd28.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

eee201bca5a6442f53bb381cc8cae7b531f99cae.english: When you live near your family, you drop in for coffee without arranging a time. At a distance, conversations become more planned, especially with a time difference. You share news, but fewer everyday moments.
eee201bca5a6442f53bb381cc8cae7b531f99cae.french: Près des siens, on passe prendre un café sans prévoir un rendez-vous. À distance, les échanges deviennent plus organisés, surtout avec le décalage horaire. On raconte les nouvelles, mais on partage moins les moments ordinaires.
eee201bca5a6442f53bb381cc8cae7b531f99cae.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f3b23ca53354a97a3cdec48250e7eb558487e081.english: Of course, distance may be easier to live with when family relationships are difficult. Choosing to move and having friends locally also help you find your place. Saying that adjusting is difficult does not mean you will be unhappy.
f3b23ca53354a97a3cdec48250e7eb558487e081.french: Bien sûr, la distance peut être plus facile à vivre quand les relations familiales sont difficiles. Un départ choisi et des amis sur place aident aussi à trouver sa place. Dire que l'adaptation est difficile ne veut pas dire qu'on sera malheureux.
f3b23ca53354a97a3cdec48250e7eb558487e081.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f3f1c06bab04d3bd2890d7b55fdec395f8aa3840.french: La relation reste forte, mais elle demande davantage d'efforts et ne se vit plus tout à fait de la même façon.
f3f1c06bab04d3bd2890d7b55fdec395f8aa3840.english: The relationship remains strong, but takes more effort and is no longer experienced in quite the same way.
f3f1c06bab04d3bd2890d7b55fdec395f8aa3840.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

f9348b750057c7f4e8aa980e37450a1f91f8dcdb.english: However, not all families are a source of support, and some people are better off living apart. Friends, a partner or neighbours can also help with day-to-day life. Being far from one’s family does not, therefore, necessarily mean being alone.
f9348b750057c7f4e8aa980e37450a1f91f8dcdb.french: Cependant, toutes les familles ne sont pas une source de soutien, et certaines personnes vivent mieux à distance. Des amis, un conjoint ou des voisins peuvent aussi aider au quotidien. Être loin de sa famille ne signifie donc pas forcément être seul.

fc28355a27d5ece851ba6f44e4691337d03fd37b.english: Phone calls keep the bond alive, but they do not always replace being there in person. You can talk regularly and still miss those spontaneous moments shared over a meal.
fc28355a27d5ece851ba6f44e4691337d03fd37b.french: Les appels entretiennent le lien, mais ne remplacent pas toujours une présence physique. On peut parler régulièrement et regretter malgré tout les moments spontanés autour d'un repas.

08281945f5694c280bf896bc396ce05742b191c6.english: Next, it is better to value effort and progress, not just the mark.
08281945f5694c280bf896bc396ce05742b191c6.french: Ensuite, il vaut mieux valoriser les efforts et les progrès, pas seulement la note.
08281945f5694c280bf896bc396ce05742b191c6.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed effort-and-progress argument; existing translation history is retained.

09d3b81bec3caeec21b3875a925094739b38bad5.english: They understand the connection between how they work and their progress. They have a method, not just a financial reason to try again.
09d3b81bec3caeec21b3875a925094739b38bad5.french: Il comprend le lien entre sa façon de travailler et ses progrès. Il dispose d'une méthode, pas seulement d'une raison financière de recommencer.
09d3b81bec3caeec21b3875a925094739b38bad5.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

0ae8c980e2e7214359eb92492d29dc0a63c90b47.english: They may therefore put less effort into this presentation, even though preparing it would allow them to learn something.
0ae8c980e2e7214359eb92492d29dc0a63c90b47.french: Il risque donc de moins s'investir dans cet exposé, même si le préparer lui permettrait d'apprendre quelque chose.
0ae8c980e2e7214359eb92492d29dc0a63c90b47.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

16c26998ce67e6700621b688c372c10689542758.english: To help them succeed again, it is better to explain what worked.
16c26998ce67e6700621b688c372c10689542758.french: Pour l'aider à réussir de nouveau, mieux vaut expliquer ce qui a fonctionné.
16c26998ce67e6700621b688c372c10689542758.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the final developed Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

176b16489cbd5cdffd1dca498206d8af360f502f.english: Money can thus make the reward take precedence over the need to understand and correct one’s mistakes.
176b16489cbd5cdffd1dca498206d8af360f502f.french: L'argent peut ainsi faire passer la récompense avant le besoin de comprendre et de corriger ses erreurs.

1962b80610f09d10cc088ecc93840c5378c5b62e.english: Her brother may become discouraged at precisely the moment when he needs recognition.
1962b80610f09d10cc088ecc93840c5378c5b62e.french: Son frère peut se décourager précisément au moment où il aurait besoin de reconnaissance.
1962b80610f09d10cc088ecc93840c5378c5b62e.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

1ada453cd5a4218b06bdb35648d5c36fe18d6bb6.french: Enfin, les encouragements doivent aussi aider l'enfant à comprendre comment s'améliorer.
1ada453cd5a4218b06bdb35648d5c36fe18d6bb6.english: Finally, encouragement should also help the child understand how to improve.
1ada453cd5a4218b06bdb35648d5c36fe18d6bb6.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

21082eff6dddf0d6974f6998c6e73352f11b322d.english: If the mark is the only thing that counts when it comes to rewards, the child may neglect the exercises that help them understand. Their effort then risks being driven by what they stand to gain, rather than by a desire to learn.
21082eff6dddf0d6974f6998c6e73352f11b322d.french: Si seule la note compte pour la récompense, l'enfant peut délaisser les exercices qui l'aident à comprendre. Son effort risque alors de dépendre de ce qu'il pourra gagner, plutôt que de l'envie d'apprendre.

214b93c3653476bc8f763674db89cf54f8727356.english: I understand a parent's wish to encourage their child, but paying for good marks is not a good foundation. Money can motivate in the short term without creating a lasting desire to learn. I prefer to recognise effort and help the child understand their progress.
214b93c3653476bc8f763674db89cf54f8727356.french: Je comprends qu'un parent veuille encourager son enfant, mais payer les bonnes notes n'est pas une bonne base. L'argent peut motiver à court terme sans créer une envie durable d'apprendre. Je préfère reconnaître les efforts et aider l'enfant à comprendre ses progrès.
214b93c3653476bc8f763674db89cf54f8727356.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

251d7f92e003413c333d3b5b1ac109d7b40c418c.english: A child adds two numbers when they should be comparing them. The parent asks them to rephrase the instruction and spots the confusion. With the teacher’s help, the child learns to identify the larger number and can try the exercise again.
251d7f92e003413c333d3b5b1ac109d7b40c418c.french: Un enfant additionne deux nombres alors qu'il faut les comparer. Le parent lui demande de reformuler la consigne et repère la confusion. Avec l'enseignant, l'enfant apprend à chercher le plus grand nombre et peut refaire l'exercice.

2ab71e63617654ee34cc0ce99515691baaa03031.english: We can also celebrate a good term at school with a family outing or a book we choose together. To me, this is a way of sharing the joy of an achievement, without promising a reward for every grade. What bothers me is automatic payment.
2ab71e63617654ee34cc0ce99515691baaa03031.french: On peut aussi fêter un bon trimestre avec une sortie en famille ou un livre choisi ensemble. Pour moi, cela permet de partager la joie d'une réussite, sans promettre une récompense pour chaque note. Ce qui me gêne, c'est le paiement automatique.
2ab71e63617654ee34cc0ce99515691baaa03031.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed French response; no provider call or DeepL original was fabricated. Existing translation history is retained.

2b1771e2fc801e364ed9c352b80a9f6d8be0d34b.english: Furthermore, a final mark does not reflect the full extent of the work done.
2b1771e2fc801e364ed9c352b80a9f6d8be0d34b.french: Ensuite, une note finale ne montre pas tout le travail accompli.

2bada2290c8ccc72dca3b8c566d0ad02fbee4d14.english: First and foremost, the child may end up working mainly for the reward.

80a3a6300b234ccba24a9350e4ca7093adb61965.english: A pupil’s mark has gone up from 8 to 12 out of 20 after several weeks of hard work. But his parents only give him money once he reaches 15. He has made real progress, without reaching the threshold that triggers the reward.

81a07ba95c8337dbfb812fd2c43c14478e007d46.french: On peut, par exemple, lui dire : « Cette fois, tu as relu les consignes et évité tes erreurs habituelles. Continue comme ça. » Il sait alors sur quoi s'appuyer au prochain contrôle.

88e7277be59218fa6b36d84bcb342998a8871da9.english: Even if the child remains motivated, a mark does not measure all their effort.

8a64fe2e82bd85d2a96d33bf86ce9396c8ee5e4c.french: En conclusion, je préfère encourager le travail et célébrer les progrès. L'essentiel, c'est que l'enfant garde l'envie d'apprendre, et pas seulement celle de gagner de l'argent.
8a64fe2e82bd85d2a96d33bf86ce9396c8ee5e4c.english: In conclusion, I prefer to encourage hard work and celebrate progress. What matters is that the child keeps the desire to learn, not just the desire to earn money.

aa81a632d074e8da5ae734be48cad58bbd223355.english: Not all children have the same strengths or face the same difficulties. If we only offer a reward once a certain mark is achieved, we risk overlooking the efforts of a child who is progressing more slowly.

d08225fa3b87d9517643a6e6bcede9ef2aeafe39.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

d483af5842bbc82cd32a2fd0cf9954fa8a7b314c.french: Je comprends qu'un parent veuille encourager son enfant, mais payer chaque bonne note ne me semble pas être la meilleure solution. Pour moi, il vaut mieux donner envie d'apprendre et reconnaître les efforts.
d483af5842bbc82cd32a2fd0cf9954fa8a7b314c.english: I understand a parent's wish to encourage their child, but paying for every good mark does not seem to me to be the best solution. To me, it is better to foster a desire to learn and recognise effort.
d483af5842bbc82cd32a2fd0cf9954fa8a7b314c.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.english: In short, I prefer to encourage hard work and celebrate progress. The main thing is to help children understand why they are learning and how they can improve.
d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.french: Bref, je préfère encourager le travail et célébrer les progrès. L'essentiel est d'aider l'enfant à comprendre pourquoi il apprend et comment il peut s'améliorer.
d5449cef3ddf6b8677ba895977fb4a3e5ab35dbc.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.deepl_english: In conclusion, you can celebrate a good mark without systematically rewarding it. I prefer to recognise progress, encourage a desire to learn and help the child where they need it.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.english: In conclusion, you can celebrate a good mark without systematically paying for it. I prefer to recognise progress, encourage a desire to learn and help the child where they need it.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.french: En conclusion, on peut fêter une bonne note sans la payer systématiquement. Je préfère reconnaître les progrès, encourager l'envie d'apprendre et aider l'enfant là où il en a besoin.
d91c9784cd155b28ba4c81a3ab13cc7cf1feb5a0.review_note: The source distinguishes celebrating a mark from paying money, not from all forms of rewarding it.

da72ae30b75fbc6b8c0219df968c247113525318.english: When a child does not understand an instruction or a method, increasing the reward does not show them how to proceed. We must first identify the difficulty and offer appropriate support.
da72ae30b75fbc6b8c0219df968c247113525318.french: Quand l'enfant ne comprend pas une consigne ou une méthode, augmenter la récompense ne lui montre pas comment procéder. Il faut d'abord repérer la difficulté et proposer un appui adapté.

e26ee6c7a7728e485ac34e34d138e0f4285c2837.english: I understand that a parent might want to encourage their child, but I wouldn’t give money for every good mark. This risks prioritising the reward over learning and failing to recognise all the effort involved. Above all, money is no substitute for the support a child might need.
e26ee6c7a7728e485ac34e34d138e0f4285c2837.french: Je comprends qu'un parent veuille encourager son enfant, mais je ne donnerais pas d'argent pour chaque bonne note. Cela risque de faire passer la récompense avant l'apprentissage et de ne pas reconnaître tous les efforts. Surtout, l'argent ne remplace pas l'aide dont un enfant peut avoir besoin.

e6df43347a423f5cb21a1df7bb42278d89df4f96.french: En effet, si chaque bonne note rapporte quelque chose, l'enfant peut finir par travailler surtout pour la récompense. Il risque alors de se demander ce qu'un exercice va lui rapporter, plutôt que ce qu'il va lui apprendre.
e6df43347a423f5cb21a1df7bb42278d89df4f96.english: If every good mark earns something, the child may end up working mainly for the reward. They may then wonder what an exercise will earn them rather than what it will teach them.
e6df43347a423f5cb21a1df7bb42278d89df4f96.review_note: Editorial English translation aligned with the complete conversational Famille response. No new DeepL translation or provider call was made.

e7c5af64afe3ccc2b6326781265561da268f9dc2.english: A child does not find every school subject equally easy. If they work regularly, learn from their mistakes and improve, their efforts deserve recognition, even if their mark is not perfect. Parents can praise them without giving them money.
e7c5af64afe3ccc2b6326781265561da268f9dc2.french: Un enfant n'a pas les mêmes facilités dans toutes les matières. S'il travaille régulièrement, apprend de ses erreurs et progresse, ses efforts méritent d'être reconnus, même si sa note n'est pas parfaite. Les parents peuvent le féliciter sans lui donner de l'argent.
e7c5af64afe3ccc2b6326781265561da268f9dc2.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the reviewed effort-and-progress argument; existing translation history is retained.

eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.english: The child understands what helped them improve and can feel proud of it, regardless of any sum of money.
eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.french: L'enfant comprend ce qui l'a fait progresser et peut en être fier, indépendamment d'une somme d'argent.
eb05409da393f1cdb21f682e4b86976c7089bbea.review_note: Human-authored English translation of the approved Famille rewrite; no new provider translation was requested.

f54443d1f53526839bb7e69d3c06d55f7b841245.french: Enfin, donner de l'argent ne remplace pas l'aide dont un enfant a besoin pour progresser.
f54443d1f53526839bb7e69d3c06d55f7b841245.english: Finally, giving a child money is no substitute for the help they need to improve.
f54443d1f53526839bb7e69d3c06d55f7b841245.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the user-approved argument that money does not replace practical help; existing translation history is retained.

f54cc055ad24758f18b99797c525bebaedeb4987.french: Un enfant n'a pas toujours les mêmes facilités dans toutes les matières. S'il travaille régulièrement, s'il apprend de ses erreurs et s'il fait des progrès, cela mérite d'être reconnu, même si la note n'est pas parfaite. Les parents peuvent encourager par des félicitations, du temps partagé ou une petite récompense symbolique, sans transformer l'école en marché.
f54cc055ad24758f18b99797c525bebaedeb4987.english: A child does not always find every school subject equally easy. If they work regularly, learn from their mistakes and make progress, that deserves recognition, even if the mark is not perfect. Parents can encourage them through praise, time together or a small symbolic reward, without turning school into a marketplace.
f54cc055ad24758f18b99797c525bebaedeb4987.review_note: Editorial English aligned with the user-approved order of regular work, learning from mistakes and progress; existing translation history is retained.
